title: Lava Beds National Monument: White-Nose Syndrome / Cave Permit
summary: Please Do Not bring clothing or caving gear used in caves or mines outside of Lava Beds into our caves. This will help slow the spread of white-nose syndrome, a bat disease that is killing bats outside of the park.
